question: Why was sodium acetate the most economically viable forward osmosis draw solution?
expect: premise false: NaCl was (LCOW USD 1.04/m3); sodium acetate USD 1.74/m3, near MgSO4's 1.75 (abstract; Conclusions)
rendered: The document does not state that sodium acetate was the most economically viable forward osmosis draw solution. In fact, it states that NaCl was the most economically viable draw solution, achieving a levelized cost of water of USD 1.04 m^− 3, which is approximately 40% below both MgSO4 (USD 1.75 m^− 3) and sodium acetate (USD 1.74 m^− 3).
